query: _fp8_cache dict in WanI2VCrossAttention/WanT2VCrossAttention caches KV by id(context) and is never cleared; when the transformer object is reused across prompts (model kept resident / loader output cached) it leaks ~0.8GB VRAM per prompt and OOMs after ~15 prompts.

desired.outcome: OP's detailed root-cause analysis: the cache is only cleared in __init__, never per prompt (wanvideo/modules/model.py); fix = clear the cache on new prompts. Masked in default workflows because loadmodel rebuilds the transformer each run. No maintainer response or merged fix.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
